# Bundled minimp3 notice

`minimp3-sys 0.3.2` declares MIT for its Rust wrapper while its build script
compiles the vendored `minimp3.c` and `minimp3/minimp3.h` implementation.
`LICENSE` contains the license text from
`minimp3-sys 0.3.2/minimp3/LICENSE` and applies to that bundled native
implementation.
